title: digitaria uniglumis
intro: Digitaria uniglumis, commonly known as Finger Grass or Finger Millet, is a type of cereal crop that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include the ability to lower cholesterol levels, aid in digestion, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Digitaria uniglumis include its potential to reduce oxidative stress, improve insulin sensitivity, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
